LanguageData.WotF_UI.DebugLog: Log per-object debug lines (turn on while diagnosing)
LanguageData.WotF_UI.EntryHidden: The floating entry is hidden. Open the bottom tech lab button to show it again.
LanguageData.WotF_UI.EntryHideTooltip: Hide the floating entry (the bottom tech lab button still opens the window)
LanguageData.WotF_UI.EntryHint: Drag the entry to move it, click it to open this window. The entry stays after the window is closed. If the entry is hidden, reopen this window from the bottom tech lab button.
LanguageData.WotF_UI.EntryTooltip: Tech lab: drag to move, click to open the window
LanguageData.WotF_UI.EquipTerrainStrideTip: Equips the strider cloak on the selected pawn: passable terrain, plants, furniture, snow and sand no longer slow the wearer.
LanguageData.WotF_UI.FreeCasting: Cast without spending mana or neural heat (development)
LanguageData.WotF_UI.GrantPsycastTip: Grants the experimental arcane missile to the selected pawn. Cast it from the pawn's gizmo bar and pick a target.
LanguageData.WotF_UI.MovementHint: The cloak cannot cross impassable cells or bypass door opening. Removing it restores normal movement costs.
LanguageData.WotF_UI.NeedPawnTip: Select a pawn on the map first.
LanguageData.WotF_UI.NoPawnHint: Select a pawn on the map to enable the actions below.
LanguageData.WotF_UI.PsycastHint: Rule: the missile only works for pawns that were granted it. Several missiles may fly at once, but each hit resolves once. Missiles track moving targets.
LanguageData.WotF_UI.RemoveApparelTip: Removes the strider cloak and ends its movement effect.
LanguageData.WotF_UI.ResetEntryPositionTip: Puts the floating entry back above the vanilla play settings row in the bottom right corner.
LanguageData.WotF_UI.RowEntryTooltip: Tech lab: open the window (the floating entry can be dragged or hidden)
LanguageData.WotF_UI.RowEntryTooltipRestore: Tech lab: open the window and restore the floating entry
LanguageData.WotF_UI.SettingsHint: Debug logging is off by default; turn it on only while diagnosing, and the game log will then carry per-object detail.
LanguageData.WotF_UI.StatusReady: Run an action after selecting a pawn; failures are reported here.
LanguageData.WotF_UI.WindowTitle: Whisper of the Forest - Tech Lab
